title: Dream Studio grader verdict — correctness role
description: The correctness grader's I/O contract. A conformant correctness provider returns a JSON object carrying correctness_score in [0,1] plus its role-specific payload (architecture violations, coverage gaps, migration gaps). Extra fields are allowed. Requiring the role's own score is what distinguishes this from the other three role contracts (WO-VERIFY-CONFORMANCE gap 0a64cf8c).
